description: Source code for anti-aliasing renderer interface in FreeType project, implementing glyph rendering, transformation, and mode setting functions.

classes.name: FT_RendererRec
classes.description: Structure representing a renderer in FreeType.

methods.name: ft_smooth_init
methods.description: Initializes the renderer and its raster.

methods.name: ft_smooth_set_mode
methods.description: Sets render-specific mode by passing mode tag and data to raster.

methods.name: ft_smooth_transform
methods.description: Transforms a glyph's outline with a matrix and translation delta.

methods.name: ft_smooth_get_cbox
methods.description: Retrieves the control box of a glyph's outline.

methods.name: ft_smooth_render_generic
methods.description: Converts a glyph outline into a bitmap with specified rendering mode and origin.

methods.name: ft_smooth_render
methods.description: Renders a glyph into a bitmap in normal mode.

methods.name: ft_smooth_render_lcd
methods.description: Renders a glyph into a bitmap in LCD horizontal mode.

methods.name: ft_smooth_render_lcd_v
methods.description: Renders a glyph into a bitmap in LCD vertical mode.
